product_overview.tagline: See where you stand — compare your income to your country and the world.
product_overview.target_user: Individuals curious about their financial standing relative to others in their country and globally.
product_overview.core_problem: People lack an easy, free tool to visualize their income's position relative to others, leading to uncertainty about their financial status.
product_overview.success_metric: Achieve 10,000 unique users within the first month of launch.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to enter my annual income and select my country so that I can see my income percentile rank.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can select a country from a dropdown, enter an annual income, and see their percentile rank displayed with an animated bar chart.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to compare my income with another country so that I can understand my financial standing globally.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can select a second country to compare against, and the tool displays side-by-side percentile ranks for both countries.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to share my income percentile result on social media so that I can engage my friends and family.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can generate a shareable image of their result and post it to social media platforms directly from the tool.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to understand how my income compares to the average income in my country so that I can gauge my financial health.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: The tool displays the average income for the selected country alongside the user's income and percentile rank.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to access a privacy policy so that I can understand how my data is handled.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can navigate to a privacy policy page that clearly outlines data usage and privacy practices.

feature_spec.user_flow: User selects country > User enters income > User clicks 'Calculate' > Percentile rank displayed.

output.percentile_rank: Displayed as an animated bar chart

feature_spec.user_flow: User selects first country > User enters income > User selects second country > Comparison displayed.
User views result > User clicks 'Share' > User selects social media platform > Shareable image generated.

output.shareable_image: Generated image of income percentile result

data_collection_plan.privacy_notes: No personal income data is sent to servers; all processing is done client-side.

launch_checklist: Set up PostHog for analytics tracking
Test all user flows and acceptance criteria
Conduct user testing and gather feedback
